svg.title: Warden against PM2
svg.desc: Bar chart of Warden against PM2 on six measurements: throughput 73.5k against 55.3k requests per second, p99 latency 2.4 against 8.5 ms, crash recovery 74 ms (25 ms with a hot standby) against 162 ms, requests lost in a rolling restart 0 against 2,093 of 6,571, warden list 2.6 ms against 156 ms, manager memory 11.9 MB against 40 MB.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bars start at zero. Shorter is better, except for throughput.
